public_supervision: Use all selected licensed and visually reviewed Open Images red/blue source boxes. Background regions use tight boxes for explicitly reviewed non-target source objects and safe padded crops for unmatched background proposals. Skip conflicting background regions. Mask every unknown image region.
control: Append the same number of existing fit frames, sampled without replacement with RNG47, to match sample count and optimizer steps. This matches frame count, not per-color box counts or supervised pixel counts; report those differences.
holdout: Keep every original grouped-holdout image and target unchanged. All public additions are TRAIN-only. Repeated grouped holdout is not independent competition qualification.
checkpoint_policy: Fresh random initialization per seed, final epoch80 only, no intermediate selection
evaluation: Export both seeds and both arms, audit proposal coverage, then evaluate unchanged blue-supplement decoder and unchanged parent crop classifier on all three development panels. Thresholds and crop budget unchanged; no promotion from training fit.
